text:
emily: Quick sync — want to lock scope for the Python/TS SDK changes we ship next sprint. Primary asks: typed function-calling, structured-output helpers, and a small embedding/rerank compatibility shim. Who owns the examples and changelog?

sanjay: I can take the typed function-calling types. Proposal: mirror TS types in Python using dataclasses + TypedDict for the webhook payloads. Minimal runtime helpers only.

marco: For structured output, we should provide validators/schemas for JSON schema -> model output mapping. Small helper to coerce partial outputs and emit diagnostics. Not a full parser library.

liz: Agree on limited scope. Customers want examples more than full-featured libs. Suggest prioritized checklist: 1) API surface parity tests, 2) concise examples (py/ts), 3) migration notes, 4) changelog entries + deprecation plan.

pranav: Embeddings/rerank shim: add a compatibility helper that accepts both dense embeddings array and our new EmbeddingVector object. Docs example showing conversion. That will unblock one inbound enterprise ask.

emily: Great. Launch criteria reminder: docs + examples exist, type defs for both clients, changelog entry, and a migration snippet for function-calling. Also CI parity (unit test that checks example snippets compile/run).

marco: Small code snippets for docs — here's a draft TS example for function calling we can use:
```ts
const res = await client.chat.create({
  model: 'rwx-large',
  messages: [...],
  functions: [ /* typed signatures */ ],
  function_call: { name: 'create_ticket' }
})
```

sanjay: And Python equivalent:
```py
res = client.chat.create(
    model='rwx-large',
    messages=[...],
    functions=[...],
    function_call={'name': 'create_ticket'}
)
```

liz: Docs-bot: can you add a checklist item to track example runnable tests and a changelog TODO?

docs-bot: @liz added checklist item: "example runnable tests" and created changelog draft PR template: docs/changelog/structured-output-function-calling.md.

pranav: Who will own the migration guide? I can draft the embeddings shim section if someone else drafts function-calling migration notes.

emily: @pranav please do embeddings. @sanjay please draft function-calling migration and short typed guide. I'll own the examples and coordinate the changelog PR. Can we aim for first draft by EOD Friday?

marco: EOD Friday works. I'll sketch the validator helpers and a tiny CLI tool for local example validation.

sanjay: I'll put a minimal TypedDict example into the Python client repo and open a draft PR.

liz: Heads-up: we need the product sign-off on the migration wording. I'll ping @kate in product. :thumbsup:

emily: Thanks team — will follow up with a brief plan and assigned PR links.
